scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @mambosite/runtime && npm run build -w @mambosite/react && npm run build -w @mambosite/theme-default && npm run build -w @mambosite/next
scripts.check:packages: npm run build:packages && npm run check -w @mambosite/runtime && npm run check -w @mambosite/react && npm run check -w @mambosite/theme-default && npm run check -w @mambosite/next
scripts.test:packages: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
